courses.title: Healing Land; Healing Lineage: Ancestral & Land Healing Practitioner Training
courses.description: Lottie's online certification course in ancestral and land healing, drawing on Irish and Celtic tradition, Native American ceremonial practice and her years in West Africa. Weekly modules cover working with the land and the elements, connecting to the ancestral line, ancestral memory, land clearing and protecting yourself, with integration weeks and two case studies before certification.
